I made more or less one year and half ago this signature thing. Initially as a way to test the osu! api when it came out, now something players can use everywhere.

It can display some stats like:

  • Your current level and a bar showing your progress to the next one
  • Your accuracy
  • Your current PP
  • Total hits in the mode you specified
  • Your rank in the mode you specified
  • Also in "userbar" flavor that only shows mode, score, accuracy, level and rank.
